subject: Two-day Meeting of the Working Group SEM in Ghent

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Two-day Meeting of the Working Group SEM in Ghent
parts:
Dear all,

The next meeting of the Working Group Structural Equation Modeling (SEM)
will take place on *16 + 17 March 2017* in Ghent (Belgium). This two day
meeting is organized to discuss methodological issues related to
Structural Equation Modeling (SEM).

The Working Group "Structural Equation Modeling" was founded in 1986.
Problems and developments of structural equation modeling are discussed
in meetings or small conferences held annually in various locations in
Europe (e.g., Germany, the Netherlands and Switzerland). The group has
an informal character. There is no affiliation to any research
organization. Exchange and presentation of methodological problems in
structural equation modeling is the main goal of the group.

Both theoretical scientists and advanced practical users with an
interest in SEM are invited to participate and submit an abstract. Talks
will be about 30 minutes including 10 to 15 minutes for discussion.
Attendance is free of charge, but registration is required.

Abstracts should be sent to Yves Rosseel (Yves.R...@UGent.be) by the
*30th of January*.

Please also use the following link to fill in your personal details:
https://webapps.ugent.be/eventManager/events/WGSEM

You will be notified on the 13th of February if your abstract is accepted.

The meeting will last for two days and includes coffee and tea breaks,
an informal conference dinner on Thursday evening, and a lunch on
Friday. Registration will take place at Thursday from 13:30 to 14:00.
The official meeting starts around 14:00 on Thursday and will end on
Friday around 18:00. The venue is an old former Dominican monastery in
the middle of the historic city of Ghent (http://www.ugent.be/het-pand/en/).

Kind regards,
Local organizers: Yves Rosseel & Mariska Barendse
Department of Data analysis, Ghent University, Belgium
